title: [Bug]:启用PlanNotebook后，使用OpenAITokenCounter时，对于plan相关工具的统计报错
body:
**<u>AgentScope is an open-source project. To involve a broader community, we recommend asking your questions in English.</u>**

**Describe the bug**
如题，启用PlanNotebook后，使用OpenAITokenCounter时，对于plan相关工具的统计时报错，提示工具json缺属性

**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:

        agent = ReActAgent(
            name="xxx",
            model=DashScopeChatModel(
                model_name="qwen3.5-plus",
                enable_thinking=False,
                multimodality=True,
                stream=True
            ),
            sys_prompt=sys_prompt,
            toolkit=toolkit,
            memory=RedisMemory(
                connection_pool=get_redis_client().connection_pool,
                session_id=session_id,
                user_id=user_id,
            ),
            formatter=DashScopeChatFormatter(),
            plan_notebook=PlanNotebook(),
            max_iters=20,
            compression_config=ReActAgent.CompressionConfig(
                enable=True,
                agent_token_counter=OpenAITokenCounter(),
                trigger_threshold=50000,
                keep_recent=3,
            ),
        )

**Expected behavior**
运行过程中使用OpenAITokenCounter统计token数量时，对于plan的相关工具调用统计报错，问题是在OpenAITokenCounter中的_calculate_tokens_for_tools方法里

开启plan会有如下工具，导致报错：
```
{
        "type": "function",
        "function": {
            "name": "view_historical_plans",
            "parameters": {
                "properties": {},
                "type": "object"
            },
            "description": "View the historical plans."
        }
    }
```

**Error messages**
  File "c:\project\python\work\agent\skill-agents\.venv\Lib\site-packages\agentscope\agent\_react_agent.py", line 437, in reply
    msg_reasoning = await self._reasoning(tool_choice)
                    ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "c:\project\python\work\agent\skill-agents\.venv\Lib\site-packages\agentscope\agent\_agent_meta.py", line 120, in async_wrapper
    current_output = await original_func(
                     ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "c:\project\python\work\agent\skill-agents\app\agents\base.py", line 57, in _reasoning
    token_in = await self.token_state.get_counter().count(
               ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "c:\project\python\work\agent\skill-agents\.venv\Lib\site-packages\agentscope\token\_openai_token_counter.py", line 378, in count
    num_tokens += _calculate_tokens_for_tools(
                  ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "c:\project\python\work\agent\skill-agents\.venv\Lib\site-packages\agentscope\token\_openai_token_counter.py", line 158, in _calculate_tokens_for_tools
    p_type = properties[key]["type"]
             ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~^^^^^^^^
KeyError: 'type'

**Environment (please complete the following information):**

- AgentScope Version: [1.0.18]
- Python Version: [3.12]
- OS: [windows]

**Additional context**
Add any other context about the problem here.

linked_prs.title: fix: handle missing 'type' field in tool parameter properties for OpenAITokenCounter
linked_prs.patch:
diff --git a/src/agentscope/token/_openai_token_counter.py b/src/agentscope/token/_openai_token_counter.py
index 8fcf4e6f7a..d0d989cd35 100644
--- a/src/agentscope/token/_openai_token_counter.py
+++ b/src/agentscope/token/_openai_token_counter.py
@@ -155,7 +155,7 @@ def _calculate_tokens_for_tools(
             for key in properties.keys():
                 func_token_count += prop_key
                 p_name = key
-                p_type = properties[key]["type"]
+                p_type = properties[key].get("type", "")
                 p_desc = (
                     properties[key].get("description", "").removesuffix(".")
                 )
